name: Deborah Harley-McClaskey
role: Leadership Consultant; Faculty Emeritus, East Tennessee State University
bio: Deborah Harley-McClaskey, Ed.D, Dr. Deborah Harley-McClaskey is a graduate of the University of South Florida and East Tennessee State University. Excellence through leadership, service and civic engagement are personal passions. As an Associate Professor and founder of Academic Leadership Programs at ETSU, she developed and teaches in the Minor in Leadership Studies and the Graduate Certificate in Community Leadership. She served on the team that developed the on-line master’s in strategic leadership for the Tennessee E-Campus Program. She has been a consultant and leadership coach to over 30 organizations and leadership teams. She is the author of the textbook, Developing Human Service Leaders, published by Sage in January of 2016. She is a co-author with Sean Covey’s coauthor for the second edition of, the 7 Habits of Highly Effective College Students (2019). She is active in the community as vice chair an advisory committee for public housing in Johnson City. Deborah is married and is the mother of two daughters, loves to hike, garden, travel, and study leadership..
